description: Initialize Isolated Production Directory: Create the gcp/ folder at the project root to guarantee that no local files are modified.
verification_criteria: The folder gcp/ exists at the root, and all subsequent work is restricted to this folder.

description: Create Production package.json: Write gcp/package.json declaring pg and other production dependencies to prevent local npm installs.
verification_criteria: gcp/package.json is created. The root package.json is left completely untouched.

description: Create Postgres Database Client: Write gcp/postgres-store.ts implementing all database methods (tickers, signals, predictions) using pg.
verification_criteria: gcp/postgres-store.ts is created and does not import or modify src/store/db.ts.

description: Create Production Server: Write gcp/server.ts to import the original createApp and dynamically hook JWT auth to rest routes.
verification_criteria: gcp/server.ts imports src/api/fastify/app.ts and registers a preHandler authenticate hook dynamically.

description: Implement Production WebSocket Security: Integrate connection authentication checks within gcp/server.ts or ws wrappers.
verification_criteria: WebSocket handshakes verify tokens using the existing configuration, without editing src/api/ws.ts.

description: Write Production Dockerfile: Create gcp/Dockerfile to build the production image using Node, Python, and the gcp/ package.json.
verification_criteria: gcp/Dockerfile is created and configured for Cloud Run deployment.

description: Verify Production Compilation: Run TypeScript compiler exclusively on the gcp/ files to check for syntax or import issues.
verification_criteria: gcp/ files compile successfully without changing any tsconfig.json properties at the root.

description: Validate Unchanged Local Tests: Run the local vitest test suite to confirm the local SQLite development pipeline remains 100% green.
verification_criteria: npm test passes successfully, proving the local pipeline has zero regression.
